defects.quote: The full-view clipped rungs (2 and 3) each significantly beat the scripted fish
defects.evidence: Turn 19: "Survival time beats random and the scripted swim-away fish". The idea doc records the same: "Every rung beats the random and scripted fish on survival time." The spec requires only rungs 2 and 3 to beat the scripted fish. Rung 4 becomes a stretch (EVAL-05: "whether the limited-view school beats the scripted fish"), and rung 1 has no scripted bar at all. The developer never weakened this in their own words; turn 21's "all five defaults are fine" is an approval, not an override.
defects.fix: Make EVAL-07 read: "Every fish-tank rung (1–4) significantly beats the scripted fish, tested with the `null-hypothesis-testing` skill at 5% after correction." Change its example to "each rung's and the scripted fish's EVAL-01 scores". Remove the limited-view school clause from EVAL-05. Update tests.md TC-46 Expected to "each of the four rungs beats the scripted fish" and drop its rung-4 stretch line. Alternatively, put the weakening to the developer as a question in the spec. Do not keep it silently.

defects.quote: In rung 3, each game's opponent for a team is the other team's latest policy with probability 0.5, and otherwise one of its saved past generations, chosen uniformly.
defects.evidence: In rung 3 both teams learn in the same game (SELF-01; AD-14: "Both teams learn in the same loop with their own PPO agents"). If each team draws its opponent separately, the predator may draw a past prey generation while the prey draws a past predator generation. Then neither latest learner plays, and a team's 'opponent' being past means that team's own latest learner isn't in the game. The contract repeats this: train.train says "each game's opponent for every learner comes from its `selfplay.OpponentPool`". As written, the mechanism can't run.
defects.fix: State the per-game rule in SELF-03, AD-14 and contract.md train.train. For example: "Each rung-3 game picks one learning side at random (or alternately). That side plays its latest policy and learns. The other side's policy is drawn from that side's pool: the latest with probability 0.5, otherwise a uniformly chosen past generation." Make TC-62's wording match.

defects.quote: **Outline:** Train the plain and clipped policy-gradient fish in the tank

defects.fix: Add an Exit under M2's Outline, e.g. "**Exit:** the tank smoke commands run; TC-29–TC-45, TC-48 and TC-49 pass; the real 5-seed tank runs pass TC-46 and TC-47 within QR-05 and QR-07."
